title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rhein Nadel Automation Gmbh
description_html:
Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.
  • Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem MINT-Fach oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung/Webentwicklung.
  • Soft-skills: Dich zeichnen deine Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen aus.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kannst dich fließend auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch verständigen.
Für die Aufgabe sind folgende Toolkenntnisse notwendig:

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in:
  • Python/Django (oder andere ORM-Tools oder fundierte SQL-Erfahrung)
  • Javascript/React (oder ähnliche Frontend-Frameworks)
- Wünschenswert:
  • Docker
  • ERP-Kenntnisse


Warum wir?

  • Hohe Gestaltungsfreiheit und Flexibilität im Zukunftsthema Digitaler Maschinenbau
  • Flache Hiararchie und Startup-Spirit
  • Idealer Mix aus mobilem Arbeiten und Office-Präsenz
  • Corporate Benefits: Urban Sports Club, Coffee Bar & Snacks, Team Events
  • Ein großartiges internationales Team, das nicht nur am Arbeitsplatz Höchstleistung erbringt, sondern auch bei gemeinsamen Events
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub

title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mayflower
description_html:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. 

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.


Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.


Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert:  Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.

title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Jedox GmbH
description_html:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Based within a European time zone.


What’s in It for You

  • Join a profitable, growing software company with a strong global presence across Europe, North America, and APAC.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly scaling cloud platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide.
  • Work on high-impact platform experiences that influence how tens of thousands of users interact with Jedox every day.
  • Collaborate with talented international teams in a culture built around #OneTeam, innovation, and impactful results.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to products that deliver real customer value.
  • Help define strategic platform decisions that will shape the Jedox experience for years to come.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.
 
If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions.

title: Account Executive – Central Europe (DACH)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bazaarvoice
description_html:
About Bazaarvoice
 
At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
 
The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.
 
Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
 
Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
 
It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

Bazaarvoice is looking for an extraordinarily talented, high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team. This role is designed for a unique, new-business hunter who craves a challenge, thrives outside their comfort zone, and possesses the strategic rigor to manage a high-value retail territory across Central Europe (DACH). 

Who we want:
  • The ideal candidate will be someone with a strong record of achievement in a new business sales position within SaaS &/or/other online based technologies.
  • Having a background selling into multiple Executive/C-Level stakeholders is a must.
  • Experience navigating through an organisation to sell a multi-solution offering, with the ability to drive urgency and be assertive in every step of your process
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous circumstances both internally and externally
  • Ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and consistently meet deadlines and objectives
  • Proven tenacity and success with prospecting your own accounts and setting your own meetings.
  • Comfort in developing a technical understanding of how our products work, to enable stronger sales cycles.

    • Key responsibilities:
  • Building and maintaining a pipeline of new prospect accounts.
  • Uncovering and understanding a client’s needs through in-depth discovery and positioning Bazaarvoice’s value according to those specific needs
  • Demonstrating the value propositions of our products and services by positioning a high-ROI solution.
  • Confidently lead a sales cycle and collaborate internally with various teams to close business (pre-sales, marketing, product specialists etc.).
  • Ability to manage and grow the territory with accurate and realistic forecasting.

    • Requirements:
  • 3+ years new business sales experience in eCommerce, digital or SaaS.
  • Follows a proven sales methodology. We use BANT which we’ll give you full training on, but we expect knowledge and experience of a recognised sales methodology.
  • Proven track-record of overachieving quota, and clear demonstrable experience of building champions in new accounts to draft mutual close plans with the client.
  • Strong work ethic: self-motivated with an ability to learn quickly and hold yourself accountable to hitting quota
  • Clear and concise communication skills, as well as effectively listen with both clients and internal business partners
  • Fluent written and oral in German and English

    • Experience nice to have:
  • Additional language skills.
  • Experience using SalesForce, Powerpoint &/or Excel
  • Full authorization to work in the EU without any restrictions, sponsorship will not be provided
    • Why join Bazaarvoice?
     
    Customer is key
    We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.  
    We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.
     
    Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust
    We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA. 
    We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance.
     
    Passionate Pursuit of Performance
    Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity. 
    We love what we do, and because we’re laser focused on our mission.
     
    Innovation over Imitation
    We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo. 
    We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage.
     
    Stronger Together
    We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives. 
    We champion what’s best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams.  
    As a stronger company we build a stronger community.
     
     
    Want to see our culture in action? Explore our global Linkedin Life Page, Life at Bazaarvoice to see the bigger picture, or visit our EMEA Life Page to meet our regional teams and see what life is like in our local offices. 
     
     
    Commitment to diversity and inclusion
     Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world’s smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers.
     
     
    Please note that a background check forms part of our final hiring process. In compliance with local regulations, this will be conducted with your consent and will strictly focus on information relevant to the position.

title: Marketing Specialist (Fixed Contract / CDD)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Quantis
description_html:
Support our people. Amplify our impact.  

  • Do you want to contribute your Marketing expertise to a mission that truly matters?  
  • Do you want to develop your professional skills through real-world responsibilities and cross-team collaboration?  
  • Are you excited to work alongside sustainability experts and support them in delivering meaningful client impact?  
  • Are you ready to join an international, purpose-driven team where curiosity, growth, and teamwork thrive?  

 

THE ROLE 

As the branch Marketing Specialist, you will drive marketing strategy and execution for the France market while co-owning global strategy for the Cosmetics & Personal Care and Pharma sectors. This role is both a local strategist and a global sector contributor — connecting local business goals with global brand direction and ensuring each sector's priorities are activated effectively in-market. 

You will report to Managing Director France and partner with the Global Marketing Lead, Global Sector Leads, branch marketing peers and the global marketing team.  

This is a 13-month fixed-term position covering a maternity leave, with structured onboarding at the start and a clean handover at the end. 

 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE QUANTIS 

Quantis, a BCG company, is a leading sustainability consultancy helping organizations address complex environmental challenges. For two decades, our expert team has partnered with organizations across the globe to bring sustainability into strategy, decision making, and action. We guide companies from ambition to action by uniting the latest science with strategic insights, helping them navigate complexity, make progress on sustainability priorities and create lasting value. 

United by a shared commitment to making meaningful progress, our 250+ professionals embody a unique, collaborative culture that we call the Quantis Spirit. We are innovative. We are impact-oriented. We are science-driven. We are Quantis.  

Learn more about Quantis and our mission.   

 

ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE OUR PEOPLE EXPERIENCE AND DRIVE IMPACT?  

  • You are a purpose-driven marketing professional eager to put your skills to work towards our mission of bridging sustainability and business value. 
  • You bring 4+ years’ B2B marketing experience in professional services or consulting, ideally in global contexts. 
  • You have proven experience in building visibility, creating engagement, and measuring impact. 
  • You are comfortable balancing strategy with execution, from research and analysis to event management and content creation. 
  • You thrive in a collaborative, international team environment and can work independently to deliver results. 
  • You know how to create engagement with peers and stakeholders, both internally and externally. 
  • You’re a team player who works efficiently, independently, and follows through on deadlines. 
  • You have excellent written and spoken communication in French and English. 

 

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Local Marketing Strategy & Execution — France 

  • Develop and execute the France marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with both local business objectives and global brand direction. 
  • Serve as the marketing partner to local leadership, helping achieve sales and client-growth goals. 
  • Activate both global and local marketing — implementing global campaigns and content, and adapting them for French audiences. 
  • Create market-specific webinars and localized content to engage clients and prospects. 
  • Manage local PR and media relationships. 

Events 

  • Lead the France event strategy and execution — executing pre-defined and new opportunities, managing logistics, and ensuring brand consistency. 

Global Sector Ownership — Cosmetics & Personal Care and Pharma 

Wearing a dual hat as sector marketing point person for both sectors: 

  • Partner with the Global Sector Lead to execute pre-defined global sector strategy and adding new activations as prioritized. 
  • Ensure all other sector strategies are activated effectively in the French market. 
  • Share sector strategy with the global marketing team for consolidation into the global plan. 
  • Coordinate execution with branch peers and global marketing when sector activities take place outside France. 

Insight & Collaboration 

  • Provide feedback and insight to global teams on local performance, opportunities, and client needs. 

 

SOME OTHER DETAILS TO CONSIDER 

  • Contract: Fixed term (CDD), 13 months, maternity cover 
  • Location: Paris 
  • Optimal start date: December 2026 
  • Punctual collaboration with other Quantis branches (Switzerland, Italy, Germany, US) via web-conference 

 

Unlocking the Potential of All Quantisians 

At Quantis, Unlocking Potential means empowering our employees to thrive, enabling them to drive our mission and manifesto forward—creating meaningful impact for people and the planet. 

We aim to achieve this by nurturing a culture rooted in collective action, and shared purpose, where diversity is cherished, inclusion is lived, mental wellbeing is supported, and opportunities are open to all.  

This extends to our clients, their clients, and their entire value chain as sustainable thinking and collective representation are integral components of our purpose to transform the way that businesses operate. 

This is how we commit to our people, live our manifesto, and shape a sustainable future - together.

title: Electronics Process Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Secheron S Dot A
description_html:
Sécheron Hasler Group continues the Swiss tradition of over 140 years in the field of railway technology. We are a leading global supplier of electrical and electronic safety components and solutions and traction power systems for the railway industry and also provide solutions for renewable energy, DC grid, and other industrial systems. The name Sécheron Hasler Group is worldwide synonymous with Swiss Quality and represents a leading reference for state-of-the-art products supplied to the market.

With more than 1400 employees worldwide, we are wherever our customers are around the globe. We supply products approved in our customers’ countries or markets and deliver top-notch supply chain and customer services locally. We are looking for a skilled Industrial Coordination Manager to join our team. The role is based in France, with a French employment contract and local employment conditions.

Main Tasks

  • Participate in the design phase to understand and integrate constraints.
  • Define and validate manufacturing processes (assembly, testing, quality control).
  • Maintain manufacturing documentation UpToDate (BOMs, routings, procedures).
  • Coordinate interactions between R&D, production, quality and procurement teams.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues during production.
  • Participate in monitoring EMS manufacturing performance in terms of production capacity, quality, cost and delivery.
  • Define and coordinate implementation of assembly and testing phases for the final product in our Prague production unit.
  • Manage and monitor orders between Prague and the EMS manufacturing plant based on annual sales forecasts.
  • Lead prototyping, pre-series and ramp-up phases of the new product.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a design office or electronic product manufacturing environment.
  • Degree in Electronics Engineering.
  • Previous experience as an Industrialization / Methods Engineer and/or Industrial Transfer Manager.
  • Experience managing technical projects, including planning, coordination, and reporting.
  • Ability to produce clear, structured, and comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of electronics, including electronic schematics, components, and industry standards (CE, RoHS, IPC, etc.).
  • Good understanding of industrial processes, including PCB assembly, testing, quality control, and traceability.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, including BOMs, mechanical drawings, and manufacturing files.
  • Experience working with CAD tools such as Altium, Eagle, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Basic knowledge of automation and testing, including test benches, microcontroller programming, and validation scripts.
  • Fluent in both French and English.

Benefits

We have flat hierarchies and encourage direct communication between departments and levels of management. This enables us to make decisions quickly.

We give our employees total responsibility for their job tasks. All employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company’s operational excellence and have ample opportunities to achieve their personal and career growth objectives.

Your success in our global company will be supported by an ambitious international team and excellent working conditions.

description_html:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

Checkout.com is one of the most exciting fintechs in the world. Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best-known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Homebase, Henkel, Tamara and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate and do their best work. That’s why we’re on the Forbes Cloud 100 list and a Great Place to Work accredited company. And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners. And we need your help. Join us to build the digital economy of tomorrow.

The Revenue Enablement Senior Specialist is responsible for supporting the UK & EEA Commercial teams, and wider Revenue Enablement team with training delivery, enablement activation initiatives, content production, process management and improvements, reporting and communication. Act as a strategic partner to the VP of UK & EEA, participating in regional leadership meetings to proactively identify productivity bottlenecks before they impact revenue.


What you will be doing:

  • Collaborating cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders and teams such as Commercial, People, Product, Operations and Marketing teams.

  • Deliver high-impact workshops and coaching sessions that drive behavioral change to new joiners and existing teams in Commercial

  • Build and refine enablement initiatives aiming to support performance improvements

  • Field ad hoc content and support requests from the Enablement leads when onboarding specific Commercial roles in the region.

  • Build training and content for e-learning and live in-person training (including Video content, Slides, and Docs)

  • Promote our CMS and LMS platform best practices (experience with any Learning and Content Management system is appreciated)

  • Maintain content libraries and repositories

  • Manage internal communication campaigns via email, Slack, and similar tools.

  • Manage data from training and other initiatives (including the analysis of data to identify and report on outcomes and gaps)

  • Supporting high-impact flagship events like Kick Off, President’s Club, and Commercial Leadership Summits

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in Sales/Commercial roles and/or Enablement/Training in FinTech, or Financial Services, or Tech, or SaaS

  • AI native, Tech-savvy and data-driven

  • Passionate about training and development

  • Experience creating video, digital marketing content, and social media content is a plus

  • Experience with Salesforce (reporting and dashboards) and Sales Engagement Tools like Clari, Groove, Salesloft, Outreach etc is a plus

  • Strong foundational knowledge of global payments (Acquiring, Issuing, Schemes, and alternative payment methods) is desired but not essential

  • Comfort and experience presenting to and influencing Director C-level stakeholders

  • Understanding of complex Business Revenue cycles

  • Great communication skills (copywriting experience is a plus)

  • Ability to prioritise and work well with others

  • Customer-focused and high attention to detail

  • Agility and adaptability in a dynamic environment

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Back End Engineer - Partner Flow
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at iwoca
description_html:
Back End Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Back End Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

  • A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

  • AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £60K – £85K

  • • £60K – £85K

description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Foundations team builds the AI-native Growth Engine, enabling Growth teams across the company. We design and ship powerful AI-driven systems, tools and automations, as well as own the core infrastructure of Growth tools such as our website, user communications and martech. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally.


The Role

As an Engineering Manager within Growth Foundations, you’ll lead and develop a team of engineers who deliver high-impact features, platforms, and tools that power our growth. You’ll ensure the team is aligned, supported, and set up to execute with excellence — turning complex challenges into simple, reliable solutions that reach users around the world. You will also stay hands-on and deliver production grade features personally every day.


The opportunity

  • Lead, mentor, and support a cross-functional team of engineers delivering growth-critical systems and features

  • Collaborate daily with Product and Design to define scope, set priorities, and ensure seamless execution

  • Keep projects moving forward — maintaining clear expectations, realistic estimates, and transparent communication with stakeholders

  • Provide technical guidance and context to help engineers make sound architectural and implementation decisions

  • Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and learning — helping the team grow their impact and autonomy

  • Improve team processes, communication, and collaboration across time zones

  • Partner with other engineering leaders to ensure consistency and best practices across the broader Growth organization

  • Leverage AI tooling daily to boost personal and team productivity

  • Stay hands-on in the codebase, writing production-grade code and setting the bar for quality, reliability, and speed

 

What you bring

  • Experience leading engineering teams and delivering high-quality results in a collaborative environment

  • Strong people leadership skills — you invest in coaching, clarity, and empowerment

  • Solid technical foundation, especially on the backend; you can engage in design discussions, code reviews, and help engineers make pragmatic decisions

  • Strong individual contributor background — you write production-grade code and lead by example

  • High proficiency in modern AI-driven development — you use AI daily to boost personal and team performance through automation

  • Familiarity with one or more modern programming languages (e.g. TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or similar)

  • A product mindset — you care about how your team’s work impacts users and moves key metrics

  • Clear communication and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineering efforts with business goals

  • Experience working in distributed, remote-first teams

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with analytics, performance/paid marketing, experimentation, or growth tooling

  • Background in developer experience, SDKs, or internal platforms

  • Exposure to scaling teams or processes during high-growth phases

How You Lead

  • You lead by setting context, not control — empowering engineers to make decisions with clarity and confidence

  • You coach through curiosity, helping others grow their judgment and autonomy

  • You communicate transparently, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and design

  • You model accountability and empathy, creating an environment of trust and shared purpose

We know that great engineers come from many backgrounds. If you're excited about the mission but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.


How We Work

We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability. We move quickly, experiment often, and learn continuously from data and user feedback. We build acquisition and engagement experiences that are fast, resilient, and measurable. We collaborate asynchronously across time zones, connected by clear communication and shared goals.

description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Senior Investigator to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

 

The opportunity

  • Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

  • Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

  • Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

  • Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

 
 

What you bring

  • Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

  • Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

 
 

Nice to haves

  • E-comms surveillance experience.

title: Senior Sales Manager UK
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Adsquare
description_html:
Intro

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.

Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Sales Team, helping accelerate our growth across the UK and international agency landscape. Adsquare is a leading data and measurement partner in the programmatic and digital advertising ecosystem, helping advertisers connect digital media investment with real-world audiences and outcomes. This role will have a particular focus on developing strategic relationships and revenue across Omnicom and IPG, alongside priority advertisers within Adsquare's ICP.


Your Mission

As Senior Sales Manager UK (f/m/d), you'll be a senior individual contributor within the Sales Team, reporting to the General Manager UK. You will own and grow strategic relationships across Omnicom and IPG in the UK and internationally, using an established senior network to unlock new opportunities with priority advertisers. You will act as a trusted commercial consultant, connecting Adsquare's data, targeting, optimisation and measurement capabilities to the needs of brands whose customers buy in, visit, or purchase through physical locations.


Your Profile

  • 6+ years of successful sales or business development experience in programmatic advertising, data, adtech or measurement, with a strong track record of delivering revenue growth.

  • Demonstrable experience selling specifically into Omnicom and IPG across the UK and/or international markets, with a strong understanding of their agency structures, buying teams and commercial decision-making processes.

  • Strong existing relationships across Omnicom and IPG, from Heads of Programmatic and senior activation/data stakeholders through to Business Directors and other senior client leads.

  • A proven network and track record across Adsquare's ICP brands - advertisers with physical stores, locations, venues or products sold through physical retail environments.

  • Consultative sales capability: able to identify client challenges, build a commercial narrative, influence senior stakeholders and convert complex data and measurement solutions into revenue.

  • Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with fluent English.


What you will do

  • Own and grow strategic revenue across Omnicom and IPG, with a particular focus on priority UK and international agency teams and their advertiser portfolios.

  • Develop and deepen senior relationships across programmatic, data, planning, investment and client leadership teams, creating access to Adsquare's priority ICP brands.

  • Build a strong new-business pipeline across brands with physical stores, locations or offline points of sale, positioning Adsquare around real-world audience intelligence and outcomes.

  • Lead consultative sales conversations from prospecting and discovery through to solution design, commercial negotiation and close, coordinating effectively with internal product, client services and leadership teams.

  • Translate Adsquare's evolving product and technology capabilities into clear client value propositions and scalable commercial opportunities.

  • Negotiate data usage and commercial agreements with key agency and advertiser partners.

  • Represent Adsquare credibly with senior agency and advertiser stakeholders, communicating the company's value proposition, positioning and vision with clarity.

  • Maintain a strong presence across the UK programmatic, agency and advertising community, using your existing network alongside targeted new-business development to generate opportunities.


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling location intelligence, audience data, optimisation, attribution, measurement or other data-driven advertising solutions.

  • Existing relationships with major advertiser accounts across retail, QSR, automotive, travel, hospitality, FMCG/CPG or other sectors where real-world customer behaviour is commercially important.


Why us?

On top of a competitive package…

  • We are open to flexible work models: we work in a hybrid mode.

  • To encourage education and professional growth, we offer an individual yearly budget of €1,200.

  • You are entitled to 30 vacation days per year.

  • Public transport contribution.

  • We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut.

  • We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive.


Salary Range (Annual On-Target Earnings)

70,000 - 75,000 £


Recruiting Process

  1. HR interview — values-based (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager interview (1 hour)

  3. Pitching interview (1 hour)

  4. Team interview, on-site (1 hour)

  5. Offer


Work model

Hybrid


Desired start date

Asap

  The team is based in three locations: the power unit is developed by Audi Formula Racing GmbH at the Audi Competence Center Motorsport in Neuburg, Germany; the chassis is engineered and race operations are managed from the state-of-the-art facilities of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil, Switzerland; while the Audi Motorsport Technology Centre UK in Bicester, United Kingdom, provides a foothold in the heart of 'Motorsport Valley', with direct access to top F1 talent and key strategic partners.
  
  What you need? The mindset of an athlete. If you are someone for whom giving up isn’t an option and limits are just something to be overcome, you can bring Vorsprung durch Technik to Formula 1 with us. Become part of this unique project and make motorsport history.
 
 We are seeking an experienced Aero Software Developer to join our high-performance team
  
  This position for the Audi Revolut F1® Team is based at Audi Motorsport Technology Centre in Bicester, UK


Your mission

  • Be the member of a team of engineers and data scientists to develop, create and improve software for efficient aerodynamic analysis.
  • Design and implementation of desktop and web applications to present data from different sources, with a focus on CFD data.
  • Contribute to the redesign and optimization of the backend used to process and serve CFD data.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of efficient workflows for CFD post-processing.
  • Work closely with aerodynamic engineers to improve the ease of understanding complex data.
  • Contribute to set future directions and trends in data analysis and data visualization.
  • Work on the look and feel of the user interface in terms of presentation and interaction with the data from a wide range of engineering data sources.
  • Design and produce high performance and well-designed data access tools and APIs to be used by other existing systems.
  • Design, code, test, release, and maintenance of data analysis applications.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements and developments in software design and data science.
  • Optimization of the backend used to process and serve CFD data.
  • Improve the look and feel of the user interface in terms of presentation and interaction with the CFD data.


Your profile

  • Master`s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related fields.
  • At least 3 years professional experience as software developer.
  • Experience with data organization and repository creation using appropriate database and file technologies.
  • Experience working on complex projects.
  • Proved programming skills.
  • Strong knowledge of Python and JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with working in a Linux environment.
  • Software release, update and deployment techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of PyQt technology and deployment to Windows/Linux OS.
  •  Strong knowledge of web technologies (Django an advantage) 
  • Familiarity with VTK, ParaView and/or PyVista.
  • Knowledge of containerized development and deployment.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Experience with scientific data visualization, especially 3D data.
  • Knowledge of containerized deployment on Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with HPC environments.
  • Data science techniques and methodologies.

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.

As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.


Your role at Aircall
  • Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product
  • Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data
  • Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance
  • Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems
  • Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients
  • Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring
  • Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback.

    • Our tech. stack:
  • AWS (Kinesis,Kafka, s3, DMS, Glue, EMR, EKS, Redshift, Spectrum), Apache Pinot, Apache Flink and Airflow.
  • A continuous deployment process based on GitLab

    • A little more about you:
  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics). 
  • 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics
  • 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript
  • Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline
  • Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift
  • Experience of query optimisation
  • Experience of kafka is a plus
  • Shipping and maintaining code in production
  • You like sharing your ideas, and you're open-minded
    •  
    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in term of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits (health coverage, lunch, commute, sports)

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion, irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations, are core to our Aircall journey. 
    We promote active inclusion to foster a strong sense of belonging which is one of our main strengths as a business. We strive to assemble diverse people that can enrich and learn from each other. We pledge to make sure everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued at the table -- providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open because we realize that we have work to do and much to learn.

title: Customer Growth Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Dataguard
description_html:
YOUR JOB

Are you excited by the idea of growing existing customers instead of chasing cold prospects? Do you thrive when commercial ownership, strategic account development and closing responsibility come together? As one of the first Account Managers at DataGuard, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of customers with significant untapped growth potential and help build our Account Management function from the ground up. If you enjoy uncovering new opportunities, expanding customer relationships and turning business challenges into commercial success, we'd love to hear from you.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You take ownership of expansion revenue across a portfolio of existing customers that has been intentionally selected for its significant growth potential

  • You help build DataGuard's Account Management function from the ground up, shaping processes, collaboration models and best practices along the way

  • You create and execute strategic account plans that uncover new use cases, engage additional stakeholders and unlock growth opportunities across your accounts

  • You turn customer needs, regulatory changes and compliance & security requirements into commercially meaningful conversations and expansion opportunities

  • You work closely with Customer Success and Professional Services, leveraging their customer insights to identify and convert opportunities into revenue

  • You build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and lead commercial discussions from discovery through to negotiation and close

  • You drive long term account growth while helping more customers benefit from the full breadth of DataGuard's Security and Compliance solutions

  • You collaborate closely with the wider Sales team and report directly to the Head of Sales, playing a key role in DataGuard's growth journey

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs.

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget.

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have experience owning revenue targets across a portfolio of existing customers, named accounts or a book of business in a B2B SaaS Environment

  • You know how to spot opportunity where others see a satisfied customer

  • You consistently uncover and convert growth opportunities into revenue through upsell, cross sell and strategic account development

  • You know how to navigate multiple stakeholders and build business cases that lead to commercial outcomes

  • You thrive in environments where not everything is fully built yet and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than a blocker

  • You are fluent in German and English

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

title: Technician (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Black Semiconductor GmbH
description_html:
The Role

Black Semiconductor is seeking a hands-on and flexible Equipment & Process Development Technician to support the installation, qualification, operation, maintenance, process development, and ramp-up of our FabONE semiconductor manufacturing facility.

You will work across CMP, wet cleaning, plating, and Graphene processes and equipment, supporting both R&D and manufacturing activities.

This is a flexible, multi-functional role where responsibilities will adapt to business priorities and FabONE needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, operation, and maintenance.

  • Perform preventive/corrective maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment recovery.

  • Act as a first responder for equipment alarms, abnormal conditions, and OOC events.

  • Monitor tool health, equipment performance, and process conditions to maintain high uptime and reliability.

  • Support CMP, wet cleaning, plating, Graphene and Chemical supply systems.

  • Manage critical consumables such as CMP pads, diamond disks, filters, PVA brushes, plating consumables, and chemicals.

  • Support process development, engineering experiments, process qualification, characterization, and optimization.

  • Support Graphene transfer, wet processing, patterning, equipment operation, and process development.

  • Assist Process and Equipment Engineers with tool tuning, recipe optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

  • Collect and document equipment/process data and maintain accurate maintenance, qualification, and process records.

  • Support development and improvement of SOPs, PM procedures, and equipment standards.

  • Follow all cleanroom, chemical handling, EHS, and contamination-control requirements.

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, EHS, R&D, and equipment suppliers.

  • Support other technical activities as required based on business and FabONE priorities.

Your Qualifications

  • Technical degree, apprenticeship, technician certification, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3-5+ years of semiconductor equipment, process, manufacturing, or technician experience.

  • Hands-on experience in one or more areas: CMP, wet cleaning, plating, wafer processing, equipment engineering, process development, or chemical systems.

  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting and maintenance experience.

  • Basic knowledge of pumps, valves, filters, tubing, sensors, motors, vacuum, chemical/fluid delivery, and equipment controls.

  • Experience with process development, equipment qualification, calibration, or optimization is a plus.

  • Graphene or advanced materials processing experience is a plus.

  • Ability to learn and support multiple equipment platforms and technologies.

  • Strong problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and documentation skills.

  • English proficiency required; German is a plus.

  • Willingness to work hands-on in a cleanroom and support a fast-paced startup/new-fab environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Safe, reliable, and available equipment.

  • Fast and effective response to equipment and process issues.

  • Stable and qualified CMP, Cleaning, Plating, and Graphene processes.

  • Strong support for R&D, engineering, and manufacturing activities.

  • Continuous improvement in uptime, reliability, process stability, quality, and efficiency.

  • Flexibility to support changing FabONE and business priorities.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect
