title: Associate Software Engineer
description_html:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description:

Defense Unicorns is seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join our UDS Product Engineering team. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and end users to help build the right solutions and build them well.

As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll grow at the intersection of product development and technical execution. You’ll contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of well-scoped features with guidance from experienced engineers, building practical experience on systems that support mission outcomes. Our engineers work across a portfolio that includes

  • UDS Data — open source data platform for all DOW mission sets from the enterprise to the edge
  • UDS Fleet — manage distributed systems across Denied, Disrupted, Intermittent, and Limited (DDIL) and fully airgapped environments
  • UDS Image Factory — developer tooling for composing complete, mission-ready system images (OS, Kubernetes, applications, configuration) into a single deployable artifact
  • UDS Foundation — core platform and tooling that power UDS, serving Platform Engineers building and operating UDS across environments
  • UDS Registry — reliably manage and deploy UDS packages to any mission environment
  • Zarf — an open source tool enabling continuous software delivery on disconnected systems

The UDS Product Engineering team values action, ownership, and focus. In this role, you’ll be supported as you build judgment, technical depth, and the confidence to take work from idea to impact.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Deliver well-tested, maintainable code for clearly scoped product features and fixes
  • Take ownership of small to medium tasks from implementation through review and release
  • Participate in design discussions and learn to connect product needs with technical tradeoffs
  • Ask good questions, clarify requirements, and make steady progress with appropriate support
  • Build growing understanding of the systems, users, and mission domains you work in
  • Develop stronger architectural design instincts by pairing with experienced engineers on larger features
  • Practice breaking ambiguous work into concrete next steps with team guidance

Responsibilities:

  • Build, ship, and maintain well-scoped features, fixes, and improvements that support mission-critical environments
  • Contribute to implementation plans and technical discussions with support from senior teammates
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to translate clear requirements into working software
  • Clarify product and technical requirements by asking thoughtful questions and documenting assumptions
  • Debug issues, improve reliability, and learn production support practices as part of the team
  • Help integrate with existing defense systems while learning interoperability and security expectations
  • Contribute to open source projects and internal tooling through scoped issues, fixes, and documentation
  • Develop and maintain clear technical documentation such as implementation notes, runbooks, and user guides
  • Participate in production support and shared on-call practices with guidance, contributing to troubleshooting, incident follow-up, and reliability improvements

As Associate Software Engineers grow, they will:

  • Take on larger feature ownership with clear expectations and regular feedback
  • Contribute to cross-functional work by communicating status, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Build deeper user and system understanding that informs better implementation decisions
  • Strengthen engineering practices through code review participation, testing, documentation, and continuous learning

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 0-5%

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a curious, adaptable engineer who is excited to learn, contribute, and take on new responsibilities as they grow.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years experience in software engineering
  • Working knowledge of Go or another modern programming language
  • Foundational understanding of software design, APIs, databases, and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Exposure to tools or projects focused on software lifecycle and delivery
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts, or interest in learning them (Controllers, Operators, CRDs)
  • Familiarity with supply chain security concepts, or interest in learning them (SBOMs, signing, scanning, etc.)
  • Experience contributing to open source projects (CNCF, ASF, OpenSSF, etc.) through coursework, personal projects, internships, or professional work is a plus
  • Ability to break down problems, learn quickly, and deliver pragmatic solutions with team support
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, with comfort asking questions and sharing progress

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$102,000—$138,000 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Manager, Software Engineering, Operations
description_html:
Want to lead engineers building software that helps pros get the job done and know exactly how their business is doing?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to be part of our SP (Service Provider) Operations group, focused on helping Service Providers run their day-to-day operations efficiently and effectively.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

We help employees grow professionally; we have a ton of onboarding resources, tutorials, hackathons and buddies to support learnings and provide opportunities to innovate. We have a range of experience levels on teams which allows for mentor/mentee opportunities. Leaders at Jobber work with empathy and support employees to build healthy work-life harmony. Bring your dedication and passion to this job to fulfill your goals.

The team:

In this role, you will manage the engineering teams behind one of Jobber's most important domains, Jobs Teams, as part of the greater SP Operations Group. The Jobs Team is at the heart of how service businesses operate, and we are constantly improving how service providers orchestrate work from start to finish so they can confidently deliver every job with quality. You will work alongside peers from Product Management, Design, and the rest of the Engineering Leadership team to ensure the tools we build help small businesses run more efficiently and grow with confidence!

The role:

As a leader within the SP Operations group, you will manage the engineering teams to deliver high quality, on time while they get to grow and learn along the way. The SP Operations group's mission is to help Service Providers run their businesses as efficiently as possible. We build the tools that help with day-to-day operations, from scheduling and managing work and crew to ensure every job gets done, to giving business owners the visibility they need to understand their business health and make informed decisions.

Reporting to a Senior Manager of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead and support their team members in developing their skills and advancing their careers—all while contributing to our mission of empowering small businesses. You'll also play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our platform, ensuring it remains reliable and high-performing as we scale Jobber.

The Manager, Software Engineering will:

  • Live and breathe performance facilitation. You want to work with your team(s) to help them master their individual crafts, while also collaborating to build extraordinary experiences and systems.

  • Be committed to the success of your people. You will help them set goals, have regular 1-on-1s, and provide constructive feedback and coaching to ensure your team's success. You’ll work to understand employees’ career direction and work to empower their journey by acting as a mentor and coach.

  • Develop a world-class team alongside a world-class organization. You’ll participate in recruiting events and the hiring process while also working to level up your internal team while implementing new processes, all to develop a world-class engineering department.

  • Remove roadblocks and build guardrails. You’ll work with the other leaders to create and maintain an environment where people can rapidly produce top-quality work that ultimately helps our customers be successful.

  • Collaborate with other stakeholders across the business. Whether it’s our Management teams within Product, or our Business Technology teams, you’re working closely with other Jobberinos to find the best solutions in Jobber for small businesses.

To be successful, you should have:

  • A track record of success in being an established software engineer, as well as time spent in a leadership position, guiding a team in the delivery of quality software.

  • Strong full-stack technical background, including design and architectural experience.

  • A drive to succeed and deliver impactful projects on time. For a high performing team with a solid roadmap that might look like getting out of their way, but for a team whose delivery is in doubt, it means getting in and getting dirty, and working with the team to find a path back to success.

  • The ability to be agile in an agile environment. You’ll need to be able to lead and teach your team to adapt to change, while also thinking critically and creatively to find answers to problems.

  • Effective written and oral communication. Being transparent with your team and establishing an open dialogue will be a key to success in supporting your coaching conversations and discussions.

  • To be a leader and mentor. You’ll bring your shared experience into conversations to influence and provide constructive feedback to direct reports throughout the journey to ensure goals are being met and exceeded.

  • Familiarity or comfort in AI tools and AI augmented development rhythms.

Highly desired, but not a dealbreaker:

  • Previous experience with our development stack: ReactJS, Typescript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL.

  • Previous experience with building zero to one projects from initial discovery and design, through implementation, and into delivery and measurement.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $169,200 CAD, a midpoint of $199,100 CAD, and a maximum salary of $228,900 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

  • A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

  • A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

  • A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

  • To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Small business owners don't just need software - they need a financial partner.

Running a home service business means juggling cash flow, fronting the cost of materials, protecting the business from risk, and helping customers afford bigger jobs. Today, most small business owners stitch this together with personal credit cards, generic bank accounts, insurance brokers who don't understand their trade, and financing options their customers can't access at the moment they need them. It's fragmented, it's expensive, and none of it is built for how they actually work.

That's the opportunity for Fintech New Bets.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets to discover, validate, and launch Jobber's next generation of financial products - in areas like insurance, consumer financing, and spend and money management (think a card offering and business banking built for Pros). This is a high-impact, highly senior individual contributor role at the intersection of zero-to-one product building and deep fintech domain expertise. You'll take loosely defined opportunities and turn them into live products with real customers and real revenue.

The team

Fintech is one of the fastest-growing parts of Jobber, and a core strategic priority for us as a company. We're investing in this growing area because we believe embedding financial tools within our product deepens our ability to help small businesses be successful.

Whether it's helping small businesses get paid using Jobber Payments, getting access to capital to invest in growth, or offering financing to our customers' customers, we believe small business owners should have seamless access to financial tools that allow them to thrive.

New Bets is the team charged with finding what comes next. As Jobber's fintech business scales beyond payments, we're expanding into new, high-impact financial products - and this role is the product leadership engine of that expansion. You'll work in close partnership with your commercial and strategy counterparts on the New Bets team, who own business cases, partner negotiations, and unit economics - together, you'll take new bets from idea, to business case, to shipped product.

Simply put, we care much more about our customers than any financial institution ever will. That's our superpower.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets who brings deep product expertise, strong zero-to-one instincts, and the ability to lead through influence across a complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes domain.

In this role, you'll own the product side of Jobber's newest fintech bets. You'll look across the financial life of a home service business - how they spend, borrow, insure, and bank - and identify which products Jobber should build, buy, or partner to deliver. You'll run rapid discovery and validation, shape build-vs-partner decisions with embedded finance and banking-as-a-service providers, and lead the first versions of these products from pilot through to scale.

Unlike our established product areas, there is no playbook here. You'll be expected to operate with high autonomy, form conviction from thin data, kill ideas that don't clear the bar, and bring cross-functional partners along with clarity and speed. This is a role for someone who is energized by ambiguity, moves fast without breaking trust, and has shipped financial products before.

As a Staff Product Manager, Fintech New Bets you will:

  • Take new bets from zero to one: frame the customer problem, size the opportunity, design and run lean validation experiments and pilots, and make evidence-based go/no-go recommendations.

  • Lead build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions, evaluating embedded finance, banking-as-a-service, insurance, and lending partners on capabilities, economics, risk, and customer experience - and shaping those partnerships alongside our commercial team.

  • Ship and scale first versions of new financial products, defining the MVP, sequencing the roadmap, and iterating quickly based on customer and market feedback.

  • Partner deeply with Design, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and GTM to navigate the regulatory and operational realities of launching financial products.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights - including unit economics, adoption signals, and risk performance - to form deep conviction about which bets deserve further investment.

  • Elevate product thinking across the fintech group, shaping how other PMs and leaders evaluate new opportunities, frame trade-offs, and make decisions in emerging financial domains.

  • Balance the urgency of proving new bets quickly with the rigor required to build durable, trustworthy financial products at scale.

To be successful, you should have:

  • Extensive product management experience, with a proven track record of taking new products from concept to launch - ideally including at least one financial product with meaningful revenue accountability.

  • Experience operating at a staff or principal level - defining strategy across ambiguous problem spaces, influencing without authority, and shaping org-wide product direction.

  • Deep familiarity with fintech products such as card issuing, spend management, business banking, insurance, or lending - and an understanding of the partner, risk, and compliance ecosystems behind them.

  • Exceptional product sense and commercial rigor. You can pressure-test unit economics and business cases as comfortably as you can critique a customer flow.

  • A bias for validated learning: you know how to de-risk a bet cheaply, when to double down, and when to walk away.

  • The ability to connect deep customer insight to long-term business strategy and communicate it clearly to senior stakeholders, external partners, and cross-functional teams.

  • A high bar for quality, ownership, and outcomes - combined with the judgment to know when to go deep and when to zoom out.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience launching embedded fintech products in a vertical SaaS or platform business

  • Experience working with banking-as-a-service or embedded finance providers, card networks, sponsor banks, insurance carriers or MGAs, or consumer lending partners.

  • Experience serving small businesses, particularly in home and field services.

title: Procurement Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Andercore
description_html:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Identify, engage, and acquire suppliers across Europe and worldwide.

  • Lead negotiations for pricing, payment terms, and contracts of €1M+ procurement spend.

  • Build strong commercial relationships that fuel company growth and ensure reliable supply.

  • Develop and execute strategic plans to drive operational growth and efficiency, aligning with the company's global objectives.

  • Collaborate with Sales and operational teams to solve issues and improve operational processes that leverage automation and data.

  • Analyze performance data, track key KPIs, and deliver actionable insights to optimize end-to-end supply chain operations.

  • Analyze market trends, supplier capabilities, and pricing structures, and adjust strategy accordingly.

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support long-term sourcing plans and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Resolve supplier-related issues, including quality, delivery, or compliance concerns.

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in procurement sourcing and supply chain contracting, and eager to take on responsibility in a fast-scaling, tech-driven environment.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality — you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are motivated by technology-driven transformation and curious about how AI can reshape global supply chains.

  • French or/and Italian Fluently and strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

What's In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one — shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best — work directly with senior operators.

  • Competitive compensation — attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility — rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture — modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join Us!

You'll be joining a company that's not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI. Here, you won't just manage supply chains — you'll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

  • • Yearly On Target Earnings (Fixed+ Bonus) €70K – €90K

title: Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lemon Markets
description_html:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.

At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. This is your opportunity to have an impact, not just on the Finance department, but also on the product, to help launch a compliant investment product.

 

You will:

  • Manage and optimize various Finance processes, especially within Accounting, but also Regulatory Reporting or Planning and Controlling, by leveraging your knowledge and expertise.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Finance on special and strategic projects, helping transition processes into scalable, best-in-class workflows.

  • Be a point of contact for our external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of high quality documentation by various teams.

  • Work together closely with the Management Team and build, monitor and refine our annual financial plan and timelines.

  • Support on product work, defining and documenting functional requirements, establishing test concepts and testing/documentation and associated implications.

  • Cultivate a culture of knowledge-sharing as you work closely with our Product Development team, bridging the gap between finance and innovation for strategic product advancements.

 

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have a strong background in Finance and regulated financial services. You have at least five years of experience in a finance function at a bank, FinTech, or another regulated institution, or with a Big Four or other leading audit firm. You have strong knowledge of German GAAP under HGB, including RechKredV or RechVersV. Knowledge of IFRS is a plus, as is experience with group accounting and consolidation.

  • You are proficient in Excel. You are comfortable using Excel to analyse financial information, prepare reports, and support finance processes. Experience with financial modelling is a plus.

  • You understand regulated financial environments. Experience in the regulated finance industry is required, and exposure to regulatory frameworks such as IFR or CRR would be particularly valuable.

  • You are willing to support in shaping the function. You are a hands-on player, willing to put high-quality processes in place from the beginning while remaining pragmatic with more complex solutions.

  • You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to deliver value by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

  • Communication and collaboration come naturally to you. You are able to communicate well with diverse audiences and explain requirements and technical topics clearly, while effectively communicating the risks and opportunities you identify.

  • You understand what working in a startup or similar lean organisation is like. You can move quickly and focus on what is truly important.

  • Growing investing opportunities excites you. Our mission resonates with you because you have worked in the financial sector, such as brokerage or banking, or in the technology sector, such as FinTech or API-first companies.

  • You are fluent in German, or comfortable working in a German-speaking regulatory environment. Fluency in German is a plus.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via

title: Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Focused
description_html:
Company Overview

 

Focused Energy is the leading laser-driven fusion company, dedicated to creating clean, limitless fusion power. We unite top scientific and engineering talent to unlock commercially viable fusion energy using proven technologies. Our goal is to drive economic growth and scientific innovation through the adoption of clean, abundant fusion energy worldwide.

 

Your Role

 

As a Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing, modeling, and optimizing advanced cryogenic thermal and fluid systems for commercial-scale fusion energy solutions. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop, simulate, and validate experimental designs, helping define the roadmap toward efficient and scalable clean energy.

 

What You’ll Do

 

  • Own the end-to-end simulation and analysis function for cryogenic thermal and fluid systems—from problem definition through model development, validation, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead analytical approaches for new and undefined challenges, applying first-principles research to create pioneering solutions.

  • Drive model validation through close collaboration with experimental engineers, comparing simulation outputs to test data, and closing performance gaps.

  • Ensure that the Cryo team’s hardware decisions are consistently supported by robust quantitative analysis.

  • Develop integrated thermal and fluid analysis packages for commercial-scale system development, conducting optimization and sensitivity studies as needed.

  • Continuously refine analysis models as new experimental, materials, and system data become available.

  • Partner closely with hardware engineers, experimentalists, and scientists to define system requirements and deliver actionable analyses for design.

  • Provide the analytical foundation for the Cryo team’s technical roadmap, guiding what gets built, tested, and scaled.

 

Who You Are

 

  • 3–5 years’ experience (or equivalent PhD research) in integrated thermal and fluid analysis involving cryogenic systems (experience with hydrogen is preferred).

  • MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong foundation in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.

  • Proficient in thermal analysis software (e.g., Thermal Desktop, COMSOL) and able to anchor analyses to real hardware.

  • Familiarity with hydrogen systems, vacuum systems, cryogenic technologies, and phase change in solids, liquids, and gases.

  • Skilled with instrumentation, sensors, and control logic for temperature, pressure, and flow in cryogenic environments.

  • Hands-on experience with test rig construction, system debugging, and low-temperature measurements to support model validation is a plus.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines, and able to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering and science teams.

 

If you are excited about advancing clean energy and eager to make impact on a groundbreaking technology, we encourage you to apply.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Praktikum Fundraising und Campaigning
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GermanZero e.V.
description_html:
Wir von GermanZero machen Deutschland klimaneutral – von unten. Als gemeinnütziger Verein treiben wir gemeinsam mit Hunderten ehrenamtlich Aktiven die Umsetzung von Klimaneutralität voran: Ort für Ort und auf Bundesebene. Mit unserem Netzwerk LocalZero unterstützen wir Städte und Gemeinden auf dem Weg zur Klimaneutralität. GermanZero ist spendenfinanziert. Die Organisation hat aktuell rund 40 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende und lebt vom bürgerschaftlichen Engagement mehrerer Hunderter ehrenamtlich Aktiven.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Du möchtest gerne in die Fundraising-Abteilung einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Themen rund um Klima und Politik zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und hast Lust, die wichtigste Kampagnen-Saison mitzubegleiten? Super! Dann bewirb dich als Praktikant:in für unser Fundraising-Team mit dem Schwerpunkt Stiftungs- & Kleinspendenfundraising! Wir suchen eine:n neue:n Praktikant:in ab 1. September oder 1. Oktober 2026.

Mögliche Aufgaben: 

  • Recherche von neuen Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen: Du identifizierst neue Trends sowie potenzielle Stiftungen, Aufrufe und Ausschreibungen, die zu unseren Projekten und strategischen Zielen passen, und erstellst Übersichten zu deren Förderkriterien und -schwerpunkten. 

  • Kampagnen-Planung & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Umsetzung für Fundraising-Kampagnen, vom ersten Konzept bis zur Ausspielung über Mail oder Social-Media – insbesondere unsere Weihnachtskampagne 

  • Mitwirkung an Kommunikationsmaßnahmen & Spendenaktionen: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Quartalsupdates, Rundmails, Spendenmailings, Förder-Aufrufen und besonderen Aktionen, die unsere Unterstützer:innen und potenzielle Fördermittelgeber:innen erreichen. 

  • Erstellen von Präsentationen und Projektvorstellungen: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Gestaltung von überzeugenden Präsentationen, um Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen für unsere Projekte zu gewinnen. 

  • Unterstützung bei der Redaktion von Anträgen: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Förderanträgen, Zwischen- und Endberichten sowie der Dokumentation von Erfolgen und erzielter Wirkung. 

  • Rundum-Blick in die digitalen Werkzeuge im Fundraising: Du erhältst Einblicke in die Nutzung von CRM-Systemen, KI-Tools & Datenbanken sowie Werkzeugen zur Projektsteuerung und zum Controlling großer Projektvorhaben. 

  • Weitere Themen: Wenn du Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du in unserem agilen Team jederzeit die Möglichkeit dazu. Wir erstellen einen umfassenden Praktikumsplan, der perfekt auf dich passt! 


  • Du bist kommunikationsfreudig, kannst gut zuhören und gehst offen auf andere Menschen zu.  

  • Du bist strukturiert und arbeitest selbstständig, erkennst aber auch deine Grenzen und scheust dich nicht, rechtzeitig nach Unterstützung oder Feedback zu fragen.  

  • Du bist sicher im Erstellen von Texten, hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail und ein feines Gespür für ansprechende Kommunikation. 

  • Du bist eine gute Teamplayer:in, behältst deine Aufgaben gut im Blick und bringst Interesse an digitalen Tools und Software-Lösungen mit. 

  • Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen, und du möchtest andere Menschen für das Thema begeistern und gemeinsam etwas bewegen  

  • Du willst zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden und Fördermittel für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist. 

Wichtig: Wir können aktuell leider nur Pflichtpraktika im Rahmen eines Studiums oder ein freiwilliges Engagement auf ehrenamtlicher Basis anbieten. Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt und regelmäßig vor Ort sein kann. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen für einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten mit 20-30 Stunden die Woche.

Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann komm in unser Team und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen!  

Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem deine Motivation deutlich wird.

Mehr Infos zu uns findest Du hier: www.germanzero.de

title: Logistiker im Bereich Maintenance / Service (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at encontec GmbH
description_html:
Wir wachsen weiter und suchen Dich zur Verstärkung unseres Instandhaltungsteams am Standort in Oberkochen als:

Logistiker im Bereich Maintenance / Service (w/m/d)


Unser Instandhaltungsteam am Standort in Oberkochen, stellt die Verfügbarkeit der Maschinen und Anlagen in Hightech-Produktionsbereichen sicher und bei Ausfällen den funktionsfähigen Zustand wieder her. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst die gesamten elektrischen/elektronischen Instandhaltungsarbeiten, die in einem Maschinen- u. Anlagenpark anfallen. Wir planen und führen Maschinen- und Anlagenumzüge durch. Mit speziellen Geräten führen wir Mess- und Kalibrierarbeiten durch. Wir stellen die Anlagensicherheit durch Prüfung gemäß DGUV-V3 sicher. Das kontinuierlich wachsende Team setzt sich aktuell aus ca. 70 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern zusammen und arbeitet im Ein- und Mehrschichtbetrieb.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Bedienung des zentralen automatisierten Lagersystems

  • Erstellung und Beantragung von SAP Nummern für Lager-Produkte

  • Optimierung und Strukturierung der Lagerwaren im Lagersystem

  • Durchführen von Ein- und Auslagerungen (SAP)

  • Bestandsüberwachung und Sicherstellung der Materialverfügbarkeit

  • Anlegen von nicht deklarierten Produkten/Materialien im Lagersystem

  • Aufnahme von neuen Materialien/Ersatzteilen im Lagersystem

  • Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe und Prozesse

  • Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterial

  • Wareneingangs- und Warenausgangsbuchungen (SAP)

  • Beantragung von Transporten und Gewährleistung des transportsicheren Versands

  • Zentrale Lagerverwaltung

Das zeichnet Dich aus

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsbearbeitung im Logistik Bereich 

  • Du kennst die gängigen MS-Office-Programme

  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse mit SAP 

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und in Schrift 

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Bei uns erhältst Du ein attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlichen Leistungszulagen wie Schichtzuschlägen sowie eine monatliche Erfolgsprämie.

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Nutze unser Jobrad-Angebot und profitiere unter anderem von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich.

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Unterstütze uns auf unserem Expansionskurs. Dafür erhältst Du einen sicheren, unbefristeten und krisenfesten Arbeitsplatz.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Du arbeitest bei uns am Standort in Oberkochen, es gibt keine täglichen Dienstreisen.

  • Professionelle Einarbeitung: Für einen guten Start in den Job, bekommst Du von uns eine intensive Einarbeitung. Erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen stehen Dir zur Seite.

  • Kollegiales Arbeitsklima: Dich erwartet ein tolles, wertschätzendes Betriebsklima. Transparenz und offene Kommunikation sind uns wichtig, damit Du dich bei uns wohlfühlst.

  • Arbeitssicherheit: Deine Sicherheit steht bei uns an erster Stelle, daher legen wir viel Wert auf Gesundheitsschutz und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz. Jede Mitarbeiterin und Mitarbeiter erhält funktionale Arbeitsbekleidung.

  • Ausstattung: Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind mit professionellem Werkzeug ausgestattet.

  • Firmenveranstaltungen und Mitarbeiterevents: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche Standortfest, die Team-Weihnachtsfeier und tolle Teamevents.

description_html:
Für unser Team und Unternehmen in Köln suchen wir einen Trainee Online-Marketing-Manager/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d), welche uns bei unseren Kundenprojekten unterstützt.

Als Trainee Online-Marketing-Manager/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) arbeitest du sehr intensiv mit unseren Kunden zusammen und verwaltest deren Werbekampagnen. Nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitung bist du ein Experte für Online Marketing / Performance-Marketing und somit auch gleichzeitig direkter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden zu Themen wie Meta-Ads, Google-Ad's, TikTok- Ads, Funnelarchitektur, Online-Sichtbarkeit, langfristiges Branding und vielen Weiteren.


Deine Aufgaben: 

  • Konzipiere, optimiere und verwalte Werbekampagnen unserer Kunden

  • Konzipiere, optimiere und verwalte Werbekampagnen für uns intern

  • Betreue individuell unterschiedlichste Brands in der Pflege

  • Arbeite eng mit unserem Video-Team zusammen um die kreativsten Video- & Image-Ads geliefert zu bekommen

  • Erstellst Reportings und Analysen der bestehenden Werbekampagnen unserer Kunden

  • Optimierung bestehender Strategien durch gezielten Einsatz unseres Know-How's

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden

  • Erfolgskontrolle  der Werbekampagnen und regelmäßiger Feedback


Für uns ist es wichtig, dass jeder Mitarbeiter die Chance erhält, sein Potenzial zu entfalten und sich selbst zu verwirklichen. Unbefristete Stellen, höhenverstellbare Tische, neue Apple Geräte, modernes Office, Boni und Gutscheine sowie jeden Tag frisches Obst sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
Wir sind ein etabliertes Familienunternehmen und legen sehr viel Wert darauf, dass hier alle an einem Strang ziehen und wir alle in einer professionellen Atmosphäre arbeiten können.

  • Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein großes empathisches Gespür

  • Vorkenntnisse in den Themen Online-Marketing, Agentur, Coaching, Beratung etc. sind von Vorteil, aber nicht notwendig

title: Teamleiter für Haushaltshilfen (m/w/d) – Quereinsteiger willkommen!
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Agentur für Haushaltshilfe GmbH
description_html:
Agentur für Haushaltshilfe

Die Nr. 1 für professionelle Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass hilfsbedürftige Menschen da leben können, wo sie sich am wohlsten fühlen – und das ist in ihrem eigenen Zuhause. Seit 2018 sind wir binnen 8 Jahren zum führenden Anbieter für Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland gewachsen. Mit mehr als 13.600 Mitarbeitern betreuen wir deutschlandweit über 110.000 Kunden. Du möchtest etwas Sinnvolles tun? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Spirit

  • Wir haben Teamgeist und wissen, dass man die besten Ergebnisse gemeinsam erzielt

  • Wir bauen auf Wertschätzung, Respekt, Motivation, Vertrauen & Verantwortung

  • Wir kommunizieren offen, ehrlich & fair

  • Wir machen Fehler, doch wir lernen daraus

  • Wir fördern individuelle Talente

  • Wir sind interkulturell

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible (familienfreundliche) Arbeitszeiten – Montag-Freitag, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (min. 30 Std./Woche)

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten – mit unbefristeter Festanstellung in einer Branche mit Zukunft

  • Individuelle Schulungen und Begleitung durch unsere Teamkoordinatoren

  • Corporate Benefits – Mitarbeiterrabatte mit exklusiven Vergünstigungen

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel – Diensthandy & Laptop

  • Team-Events – wie Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier

Nach der Probezeit:

  • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung – Gesundheitsbudget von 600€ pro Jahr

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – plus Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • TOP Dienstwagen mit Tankkarte – zur vollen privaten Nutzung (nach bestimmten Kriterien)

  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket (bezuschusst)

  • Jobbike


Deine Rolle

  • Du bist das Gesicht der Agentur für Haushaltshilfe in deiner Region

  • Marketing- und Vertriebsmaßnahmen – Aufbau deines eigenen Teams aus Haushaltshilfen und Kunden

  • Koordinierung deines Teams – Betreuung aller hilfsbedürftigen Kunden in deinem Bezirk sicherstellen

  • Ansprechpartner für deinen Bezirk – du vertrittst deinen Bezirk bei allen Anliegen und Entscheidungen gegenüber der Zentrale

Selbstverständlich bist du nicht allein. Unser Team in der Zentrale hält dir den Rücken frei und unterstützt dich tatkräftig beim Ausbau deines Bezirks und beim Führen deines Teams.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eigenverantwortliches und selbstständiges Handeln

  • Kontaktfreudig, kommunikativ und schaffst gerne Verbindungen zwischen Menschen

  • Sorgfältige, nachhaltige und gründliche Arbeitsweise

  • Stehst gern im Mittelpunkt und machst dich in deiner Region bekannt

  • Du möchtest dich beruflich umorientieren? Werde Teil des Teams, Quereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen!

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1)

Jetzt bewerben und Leben verändern!

title: Expansion Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Distribusion Technologies
description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

  • Originate, negotiate and close partnerships with airport transfer operators, supported by compelling and tailored commercial propositions

  • Build senior relationships with operators, airports, airport authorities and relevant local partners to unlock market access and growth

  • Coordinate internal teams through contracting, integration, launch and ramp-up

  • Own post-launch commercial performance, identify gaps and drive corrective actions

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid or Europe & Remote


Who you are:

  • You bring 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or 3-5 years in sales, business development, or a commercial role at a high-growth tech company.

  • You have a track record of taking ownership of a commercial area and growing it: markets deepened, strategies sharpened, results delivered

  • You can navigate product complexity and translate it into a compelling sales narrative; experience as a tech BD or sales engineer with full commercial cycle ownership is a strong signal

  • Experience in a tech company, marketplace, or platform business is a strong advantage; B2B sales experience is a plus

  • A background in consulting, or experience at a high-growth tech platform or fast-scaling startup, tells us a lot about your operating style

  • You are self-driven, independent, and resourceful; you thrive with full ownership and minimal guidance

  • You collaborate well in a matrixed environment and bring positive ambition to teams where others are also running their own markets

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • You are fluent in English (spoken and written); an additional European language, French, German, or others, is a big plus

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

description_html:
sofatutor ist eine digitale Lernplattform für fast 2 Millionen Kinder, Schüler*innen, Eltern und Lehrkräfte. Als Public Affairs Manager gestaltest du die Bildungspolitik in Deutschland aktiv mit: Du vertrittst sofatutor in der Politik, vernetzt dich mit Ministerien, Ländern und Verbänden und treibst digitale Bildung voran. Gemeinsam mit dem Director Schools bewegst du dich sicher in den Schaltzentren der Bildungspolitik – von Kultusministerien bis zu kommunalen Schulträgern.

📍 remote innerhalb Deutschlands | ⏳ 40 h / Woche

Dein Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Netzwerkarbeit: Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Politik, Ministerien, Schulträgern – insbesondere in den Bundesländern.

  • Repräsentanz: Repräsentation von sofatutor auf Konferenzen, Messen, öffentlichen Veranstaltungen und in Ausschüssen.

  • Monitoring und Strategieentwicklung: Überwachung regulatorischer Entwicklungen sowie Erstellung strategischer Handlungsempfehlungen für unser Team und unsere Organisation.

  • Vertrieb & Verhandlung: Direktvertrieb unserer Schulprodukte an Länder, Schulträger und kommunale Bildungseinrichtungen sowie erfolgreiche Verhandlung von Produktoptionen und Vertragsbedingungen.

  • Politische Kommunikation: Erstellung von Positionspapieren, Briefings und politischen Kommunikationsmaterialien.


Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Public Affairs, Government Relations, politischer Kommunikation oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – idealerweise mit Bezug zur (digitalen) Bildungsbranche.

  • Kenntnisse relevanter bildungspolitischer Institutionen und Prozesse (KMK, Bund, Bildungsministerien, Schulgesetze der Länder).

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit politischen Entscheidungsträger*innen und öffentlichen Institutionen sowie Verständnis der dazugehörigen Entscheidungsprozesse.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit,  komplexe Sachverhalte für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen prägnant aufzubereiten. 

  • Freude am Netzwerken und Lust, sofatutor mit Vorträgen oder in Podiumsdiskussionen eine Stimme zu geben.

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, um sofatutor regelmäßig auf Messen oder anderen Netzwerktreffen zu repräsentieren (ca. 1-2 Mal pro Monat).

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Kommunikation.


Das bieten wir dir:

  • 🕒 Flexibilität: flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, remote-first Arbeitsmodell, Arbeit aus dem EU-Ausland für 180 Tage / Jahr

  • 💻 Mobiles Arbeiten: Laptop, Headset, Monitor + 100 € Zuschuss für Equipment 

  • 🌍 Mobilität: Zuschuss zu ÖPNV-Tickets, Swapfiets Fahrräder

  • 🎉 Gemeinschaft: regelmäßige Team-Events, remote oder vor Ort in Berlin

  • 💚 Ehrenamt & freie Tage: Zwei freie Tage / Jahr für Ehrenamt + freie Tage an Heiligabend & Silvester

  • 💪🏻 Wohlbefinden: Urban Sports Club, Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaften, Zugang zu Bloom

  • 💸 Rabatte: FutureBens, Corporate Benefits, Rabatte auf sofatutor-Produkt

Wir bei sofatutor arbeiten jeden Tag daran, unser integratives Arbeitsumfeld so weiterzuentwickeln, dass deine Entwicklung unabhängig von Geschlecht, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Religionszugehörigkeit, Alter, Behinderungsgrad, Bildungsstand oder Ethnie gefördert wird. Unterstütze uns gern dabei und schließe dich an!

title: Interim CRO / Chief Restructuring Officer (m/w/d)

description_html:
enomyc – Wir gestalten den Mittelstand von morgen.

Wenn Unternehmen in herausfordernde Situationen geraten, braucht es Erfahrung, Klarheit und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Für aktuelle und zukünftige Mandate bei mittelständischen Unternehmen bauen wir unser enomyc Interim Executive Network gezielt weiter aus und suchen erfahrene Chief Restructuring Officers (CRO) und Restrukturierungsmanager:innen, die Unternehmen in anspruchsvollen Transformations-, Turnaround- und Krisensituationen operativ begleiten.

Als Interim CRO arbeitest du eng mit unseren Partner:innen und Projektteams zusammen – und übernimmst beim Mandanten dort Verantwortung, wo schnelle Entscheidungen, belastbare Zahlen und konsequente Umsetzung gefragt sind.

Deine möglichen Mandate

Je nach Unternehmenssituation übernimmst du als CRO, Sanierungsmanager:in oder mit entsprechender Vollmacht Verantwortung für:

  • Steuerung von Restrukturierungs- und Turnaround-Situationen im Mittelstand

  • Entwicklung und konsequente Umsetzung von Sanierungs- und Maßnahmenprogrammen

  • Sicherstellung von Liquidität und Finanzierung

  • Steuerung integrierter Unternehmens- und kurzfristiger Liquiditätsplanungen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Finanzierungspartnern, Gesellschaftern und weiteren Stakeholdern

  • Begleitung von IDW S6-, IBR- und ggf. insolvenznahen Situationen

  • Umsetzung operativer und finanzwirtschaftlicher Restrukturierungsmaßnahmen

  • Führung von Managementteams und Steuerung kritischer Entscheidungsprozesse

  • je nach Mandat Übernahme weitreichender operativer Verantwortung

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als CRO, Restrukturierungsmanager:in, CFO in der Krise oder Sanierungsberater:in

  • nachweisbare Restrukturierungs- und Turnaround-Erfahrung im deutschen Mittelstand

  • fundierte Erfahrung mit Liquiditätssteuerung, integrierter Planung und Finanzierung

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit IDW S6 / IBR und den relevanten Stakeholdern einer Restrukturierung

  • ausgeprägte Umsetzungsstärke – du analysierst nicht nur, sondern setzt Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen um

  • souveräner Umgang mit Geschäftsführungen, Gesellschaftern, Banken und Finanzierungspartnern

  • Bereitschaft zu einer substanziellen Vor-Ort-Präsenz beim Mandanten

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • kurzfristige bzw. projektbezogene Verfügbarkeit als selbstständige:r Interim Manager:in

Zusammenarbeit mit enomyc

Wir bieten dir keine klassische Freelancer-Börse, sondern die Möglichkeit, Teil unseres Interim Executive Networks zu werden.

Dich erwarten:

  • anspruchsvolle Restrukturierungs- und Transformationsmandate im Mittelstand

  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen enomyc Partner:innen und Beratungsteams

  • klar definierte Mandate, Laufzeiten und Tagessätze

  • Einbindung deiner operativen Expertise in unsere Beratungsmandate

  • die Möglichkeit, auch in Interim-Teams gemeinsam mit weiteren Spezialist:innen Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit über einzelne Mandate hinaus

Für ein schnelles Matching interessieren uns insbesondere deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit, dein Tagessatz, deine Reisebereitschaft sowie ausgewählte Referenzmandate.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Anne Rienecker, Head of People Advisory.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, wenn Unternehmen sie am dringendsten brauchen?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich für unser Interim Executive Network kennenzulernen.

title: Head of Public Affairs (Germany & EU) @ AI Infrastructure Venture, Dresden
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at atlantic.vc
description_html:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We're building next-generation HPC and AI infrastructure for a world where brute-force compute is reaching its limits. Our chip and system architecture is designed to exploit sparsity at scale, focusing compute where it matters most and eliminating unnecessary computation everywhere else. That means orders-of-magnitude gains in performance and efficiency. We're based in Dresden and working at the intersection of deep tech, European industrial policy, and the global AI race.

About the Role

This is a senior hire at the centre of how we engage with government, regulators, and the broader European policy landscape. You'll lead our public affairs strategy across Germany and the EU, shaping how we're positioned in some of the most consequential policy debates of the decade: AI, semiconductors, digital sovereignty, and high-performance computing. You'll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, with real ownership over how we show up in Berlin and Brussels.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute our public affairs strategy across German federal and regional government, and EU institutions in Brussels

  • Monitor and anticipate regulatory, legislative, and geopolitical developments that affect our business

  • Build and maintain relationships with policymakers, institutional partners, and government stakeholders

  • Represent us in high-level meetings, consultations, and policy forums in Berlin and Brussels

  • Position us as a recognised voice in European AI infrastructure and deep tech

  • Engage with industry alliances, think tanks, and research institutions across Germany and the EU

  • Identify and support access to public funding programmes, including Horizon Europe, the Chips Act, IPCEI, and national innovation programmes

  • Drive participation in strategic consortia and collaborative European initiatives

  • Develop policy narratives around AI, compute infrastructure, and European competitiveness

  • Contribute to position papers, consultation responses, and public communications

  • Support CEO and leadership visibility in policy and industry discussions

  • Advise internally on regulatory risks and opportunities, helping align corporate strategy with the political landscape

About You

You understand how policy gets made in Berlin and Brussels, and you know how to get a deep tech company into the right rooms. You're equally comfortable briefing a minister, drafting a position paper, or working with an engineering team to translate what we do into language that resonates with policymakers. You think strategically but you're hands-on, and you're motivated by the idea of shaping European technology policy from inside a company that's building something genuinely new.

  • Significant experience in public affairs, government relations, or policy, with a strong track record across both Germany and EU institutions

  • Background in deep tech, AI, semiconductors, or advanced computing

  • An established network in Berlin and / or Brussels policy circles

  • Experience working within or alongside startups or scale-ups, not just large corporates

  • Able to translate complex technical topics into clear, accessible messaging for non-technical audiences

  • Professional fluency in both English and German

Nice to have:

  • Additional EU languages

  • Experience with IPCEI processes or large-scale European consortium programmes

  • Familiarity with German federal and regional funding landscapes

Why Join

We're at an inflection point. The European policy environment around AI, semiconductors, and compute infrastructure is moving fast, and we're right in the middle of it. This role gives you direct influence over how a deep tech company engages with some of the most important policy debates in Europe today. You'll work closely with the CEO, have genuine ownership of the strategy, and help shape how Europe builds its compute future. We offer relocation support and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

title: Founder Associate (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at atlantic.vc
description_html:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

About the Role

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. A lot of it is commercial: working out who needs us, getting into conversations with them, understanding what they run and what it costs them. The rest is everything else that needs doing when a company is this young. We closed our pre-seed in 3 weeks and are now preparing our first customer pilots, so there is a lot of ground to cover and very few people to cover it. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself.

What you'll do

  • Work alongside the founder on the priorities that matter most, which will change as we grow.

  • Research the market and help us work out who our best customers are and why.

  • Build target lists, write outreach and get conversations started with technology and software companies in DACH.

  • Join customer conversations, take notes that matter and turn what you hear into sharper positioning.

  • Learn how customers run their AI workloads, what those workloads cost and the quality standards they need.

  • Set up the tools, CRM and processes we need to keep track of customers as the volume grows.

  • Use AI throughout your own work so a team of our size can cover far more ground.

  • Prepare materials for customers, investors and partners.

  • Pick up the unglamorous groundwork nobody else has got to yet.

About You

We are looking for someone early in their career who learns quickly and takes on more than the title suggests. You will not have done most of this before, and that is fine. What matters is that you are curious about customers, comfortable without much structure, and inclined to work out the answer yourself before asking for it.

  • You have spent some time in a startup, a venture fund, consulting or a commercial role, whether through a job, an internship or something you built yourself.

  • You enjoy talking to people you have not met before and can hold your own with commercial and technical audiences alike.

  • You write clearly and can turn messy input into something structured.

  • You are comfortable with software and already use AI tools well in your own work.

  • You are interested in AI infrastructure, developer tools or enterprise software, and can pick up a technical product quickly.

  • You create structure from ambiguity and stay practical about what it takes to get results.

  • Fluent English is required. Fluent German is a strong advantage.

Why Join

You will join at the earliest stage, work next to the founder every day and watch decisions get made rather than hear about them later. The role is broad on purpose, so what you own will grow as fast as you do, with a clear path into a commercial or operating role as the team grows. The pace is high and the timelines are ambitious, and that asks a lot of everyone here. It suits someone who wants real responsibility early and is motivated by building something at speed.

This is a full-time role based in our Berlin office 5 days a week, with a start date as soon as possible.
